summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown celebrated Diwali with little children at Guild of Service, Naigon, by distributing new festive dresses, toiletries and sweets.
description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown celebrated Diwali with little children at Guild of Service, Naigon, by distributing new festive dresses, toiletries and sweets.

The excitement and happiness on the children's faces made the celebration truly heartwarming. The initiative brought festive cheer and made the children feel special and included during this joyous occasion.

Diwali is a festival of lights, hope and happiness. The real celebration lies in sharing what we have and bringing smiles to those around us.

We may gift a dress or a box of sweets, but the happiness and memories we create are priceless.

Let's continue spreading smiles, one little heart at a time!
